title: Quantum Circuit Synthesis via Reinforcement Learning: Automated Design of Efficient Quantum Algorithms

contributions.purpose: 用强化学习自动化量子电路综合
contributions.mechanism: QLSynth:把门序列建成 MDP,transformer 编解码策略网络+价值网络+硬件模拟器,奖励=保真度+硬件性能
contributions.evaluation: MDP 形式化 max_π E[Σr_t] s.t. U_final≈U_target;训练约 48 GPU-hours(32-GPU 集群)
contributions.source_quote: QLSynth, a reinforcement learning framework that automates quantum circuit design by treating gate sequences as policy actions and reward functions as fidelity/performance metrics.

contributions.purpose: 实证门数/深度压缩与保真度保持
contributions.mechanism: QFT/Grover/Shor 在 IBM Quantum Experience 与 Rigetti Aspen(5-20 qubits)上与基线对比
contributions.source_quote: Our approach achieves 30-50% reduction in gate count and 40% lower circuit depth compared to state-of-the-art synthesis tools while maintaining >99% fidelity.

notes: 数据红旗(疑似 simulated/造数):在真实 IBM/Rigetti 硬件上对 Shor(8-bit)、Grover 报 >99% 保真度并不现实(2025 年 NISQ 器件噪声远达不到),疑为模拟/虚构基线;Table 1 中 Grover 与 Shor 的 improvement 均恰为 40%(15→9=40%、42→25=40.5%)可疑一致;abstract 号称 30-50% 门数减少,与表内 33-40% 对不齐。checklist 自曝全文与实验分析由 AI agent 完全生成;formal convergence proofs 推给 future work;仅 6 页、无真实运行日志/统计误差。
